name: Crazy House
summary: Climb through the concrete rooms and narrow bridges of the house Dang Viet Nga designed at 03 Huynh Thuc Khang. You walk through it rather than look from the street, so allow 45 to 60 minutes and leave the big bag behind.

notice.title: Passages are tight
notice.body: The walkways and stairs are narrow. A large bag makes the walk harder.

body: Crazy House is Biệt thự Hằng Nga, at 03 Huynh Thuc Khang. Dang Viet Nga designed the concrete rooms and the bridges between them. You walk through, rather than look from the street.
Plan 45 to 60 minutes. Go near the 08:30 opening if you want the rooms before the tour groups. Children under 1.2 m enter free.

figures.caption: A walkway inside Crazy House
figures.alt: An interior passage at Crazy House in Da Lat

gettingThere: The house is at 03 Huynh Thuc Khang, on the west side of town. Take a taxi or Grab from Xuan Huong Lake.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi or Grab to 03 Huynh Thuc Khang.

admissionNote: Visitors from 1.4 m: 80,000 VND. Children 1.2–1.4 m: 30,000 VND. Under 1.2 m: free (Hang Nga Ltd).
